_comment: Unique finisher of every imported species, keyed by species id. Authored design data: docs/mods/unique-finishers.md explains every field. "move" is what the battle uses (written to the species record, read through modSpeciesMove); the name goes to the text banks as species.<id>.finisher. The effect chunk itself is the species JSON "own_effect". "neutral": false plays these numbers; true writes none: every import keeps the DW1 numbers of the finisher it replaces, while its name and own effect still apply.

behavior.look: Cold glints run to the paws, a blue streak leaps at the target and two rakes of three claws tear across it one after the other.
A black cog winds up before Hagurumon in a dark haze, rolls into the target and grinds on it in a shower of sparks before flying apart.

finishers.name: Recovery Power

behavior.look: Snowflakes gather into a lamp on the chest, a thin cold beam with frost hoops running down it opens a great snowflake on the target.

finishers.notes: Source cures confusion, poison and stun and heals; a buff would need engine code, so this damaging beam is the finisher.

finishers.name: Brachio Bubble

behavior.look: A bubble swells at the mouth to the size of a Digimon, wobbles after the target with small bubbles in its wake and bursts on it in a ring of spray.

finishers.notes: Its specialties are Fire/Battle, so the bubble is Battle.

behavior.look: A blue light swells on the brow and shoots head first at the target as a blunt comet, and a great white V flashes up where it butts.
Three wooden mallets drop on strings onto the target, left, right and middle, each knocking a jagged star and splinters out of it.

finishers.name: Poison Wing

behavior.look: Both wings glow and each throws a front of sickly green heat; the two close on the target and it goes up in green and orange flame.

finishers.notes: Hand-made import, DW2 skill; canon "Heat Viper".

behavior.look: A spat ball of silk opens in the air into a turning net that falls over the target and draws tight round it.
A glint on the brow feather fires a hair-thin red beam that stings the target with a star and leaves red feathers tumbling.
A curled, plated ball rolls along the ground at the target kicking up dust and bounces off it in a burst of grit.
A pink point lights on the wrist, two feints flick out, then a long green spike runs the target through and sparks fly out of its far side.
A light climbs into the air and dives on the target as a white dart, leaving shock rings in the sky and three booming rings where it lands.
A spiked ball of stone swings over in a high arc and slams down on the target; rocks fly, dust rolls out in a ring and the ground jumps a second time.
A golden bow forms as light gathers on it and looses one arrow of rose light that breaks in a cross of light and falling feathers; it can be dodged.

finishers.name: Metal Wolf Claw

behavior.look: A broad freezing beam from the jaws sheds rime and raises spikes of ice round the target that shatter.

finishers.notes: Canon "Cocytus Breath" style beam.

finishers.name: Positron Laser

behavior.look: Hoops close on the arm cannon, then a huge orange beam with hoops racing down it whitens the screen and bursts on the target.

finishers.notes: Canon "Positron Laser": the source's "Mega Fire" read too close to DW1's Mega Flame.

behavior.look: Five spinning golden drills fly out one after another on bright wakes and bore into the target in bursts of gold chips.
The X on the chest swells, tears loose and flies at the target as a growing burning X that stamps it with a blaze.
Flames wreathe the caster and leave it as a lance of fire with two flames corkscrewing round it, which blows a cone of fire out of the target.
Wind whips round the caster and drills to the target as a sideways whirlwind of hoops and coiling streaks that blows apart on it.
Four crackling plasma orbs charge above the caster, then dive one by one and burst on the target in white-gold flares.

finishers.name: Rocking Stone

behavior.look: Two carved stone tablets form in shafts of sunlight over the target and drop one after the other in dust and chips of stone.

finishers.notes: Element follows the specialties (Air/Fire); stone suits neither.

behavior.look: Two hip guns fire in turn a row of blue tracers with muzzle flashes and flung cases, each flaring and sparking on the target before a last star burst.
A shower of five-pointed stars falls from the sky on glittering tails and bursts on the target one after another.
A jagged bolt that changes shape every instant stands between the jaws and the target while arcs crawl over it.
Bubbles rise and a sonar ring pings out, then a steel torpedo runs at the target in a wake of foam and throws up a column of spray.
The V on the chest flares gold and pours a roaring band of flame that bursts on the target as a great golden V.

finishers.name: Horn Buster

behavior.look: Arcs feed a ball of lightning swelling on the horn; it is flung in a straight line and bursts in a ringed shock, leaving current on the target.

finishers.notes: Electrical = Air in DW1.

finishers.name: Gate of Destiny

behavior.look: A spark draws a golden round gate behind the target; it opens on white light, pulls lights out of the target and flares.

finishers.notes: Source "The Gate of Destiny"; article dropped to fit.

behavior.look: Seven holy orbs turn as a wheel around the caster, then strike the target in turn under a pillar of light and drifting feathers.
A green whirl spins at the caster and sprays volleys of white needles that prick the target in green bursts.
A pink flower opens and turns between the hands and fires a green beam that bursts on the target in a cloud of petals.
Two violet mandibles close on the target from either side in two crossing cuts, and the black X they leave bursts.
Hoops close on the nose cannon and a thick river of blue power sprays drops and raises a column of water on the target.
A toothed maw opens on the chest and pours a crimson blast with a black heart that leaves a dark blot and rising red bubbles.
Lights from the two wingtips meet at the chest and a V-shaped blade of light is flung straight ahead, growing, with echoes behind it.
Three clay figures tumble in high arcs onto the target's spot and burst into potsherds and red dust.
Two ropes of rose flame coil round each other to the target and wind up into a spinning funnel of fire.
Four red eyes open, a red streak lunges at the target and three talons rake down through it side by side, dragging trails of red.
A file of blue and striped orange fish leaps out in arcs and slaps into the target with splashing crowns of water.
The horn leaves the head on a jet of flame trailing smoke and bursts into frost and splinters of ice; it can be dodged.

finishers.name: Vulcan's Hammer

behavior.look: Sparks run up into a hammer hanging over the target; it drops, and rings of energy burst out twice with bolts dancing over the spot.

finishers.notes: An electric hammer is an open request (ideas.md); Air is not among its specialties.

behavior.look: Two spiked balls of ice whirl round Vikemon, then a gale of snow and flakes blows over the target and spikes of ice grow from the ground under it and break.
Four howls leave the mouth as widening sound rings with tumbling notes and keep ringing over the target.

finishers.name: Cat's Eyes

source.name: Cat's Eyes
source.note: BlackGatomon card, triangle... third attack (Lightning Paw is shared with Gatomon)

behavior.look: The light dims, two yellow cat's eyes open and flash, violet ripples cross to the target and huge eyes open over it in a violet haze.

finishers.notes: Lightning Paw stays with Gatomon (canon owner). No status: the card data has none.

behavior.look: A swarm of bats pours out of a cloud of gloom and tears across the target in violet slashes before scattering.

finishers.name: Trident Arm

source.note: recoloured DW1 MetalGreymon; canon MetalGreymon (Vaccine) attack

behavior.look: The metal claw shoots out on a chain, clamps the target in a burst of sparks, wrenches it and reels back.

finishers.notes: Recoloured native: it used MetalGreymon's Giga Destroyer (79).

behavior.look: Two great shuriken spin up at Shurimon's sides in a swirl of leaves and are flung straight at the target one after the other.
A light from each hand joins into a red and white sphere with wind wound round it; thrown, it breaks on the target in a whirl of gusts.
The bone club is hurled end over end in a high arc, lands with a crack, splinters and dust, and bounces away.
Burning rocks spiral down in a dance and crash on the spot where the target stood in bursts of fire.
Wisps of shadow gather, a dark spinning crescent flies to the target and reaps through it in one wide pale sweep.

finishers.name: Thorny Whipping

behavior.look: A thorned vine lashes the target three times, high, low and over the top, each crack throwing rose petals and leaves.

finishers.notes: Source spelling "Throny" corrected.

finishers.name: Shell Attack

behavior.look: Slime bubbles up and a pink spiral shell is lobbed high, spinning and dripping, lands on the target's head and bounces off in a green splash.

finishers.notes: Source "Shell's Attack"; possessive dropped.

behavior.look: A big round bomb with a spitting fuse is lobbed high and goes up in a fireball, a blast ring and rolling black smoke.
Three scalding bubbles blown one after another hop through the air steaming and burst on the target in boiling water.
Gold sparks crackle on the paw, a bolt jumps to the target and a great glowing paw print stamps on it in a shower of stars.
The head flame swells, tears free and is flung in a high arc dripping wax; a ring of small flames stands up where it lands; it can be dodged.
A syringe loaded with violet serum is thrown like a dart, dripping as it flies, and bursts in a violet spray.
A hollow red ball with a black heart swells on the chest and tears open into a ragged red torrent with a black core that bursts on the target and leaves soot.

finishers.name: Pulse Blast

behavior.look: Six rings of sound leave the head one after another, swelling as they swim to the target and breaking on it in ripples.

finishers.notes: Sound = Air.

behavior.look: A toothed teal blade spins up, runs at the target throwing sparks, bites in and grinds there before the cut goes through.
Three jagged lumps of coral hurled one after another, each spinning in a sheath of sea water and breaking where it lands; they can be dodged.
Sparks at the tip of the staff knot into a ball of lightning that rolls after the target and forks out all round it.
A sparkling fog rolls from the staff to the target and closes round it; six ice crystals circle in the fog, draw in and shatter together.
A burning gate opens high above the caster and a stream of bright stars pours down from it on fiery tails into the target.
A cluster of cold blue comets plunges from the sky on tall wakes onto the spot where the target stood and ends in a white nova.
Four swords appear in a fan over Piedmon with a wink of magic, then fly at the target one after another on pink trails.

finishers.name: Hades' Grenade

behavior.look: Darkness gathers in the mouth into a black ball veined with fire, shot straight and smoking; it bursts into a pillar of hellfire; it can be dodged.

finishers.notes: Apostrophe: check every font.

behavior.look: Current hums on Kokuwamon; two toothed steel blades snap shut on the target from the sides, then two more from above and below, and the current jumps over it.

finishers.name: Ocean Love

behavior.look: Three bubbles with a pink heart in each float swaying into the target and burst into small hearts; a great heart opens over it at the end.

finishers.notes: Canon calms the target; no status in the card data.

behavior.look: Five growing fronts of freezing wind cross to the target one after another; the first freezes it in a star of frost and icy feathers fly from each that follows.
A ball of fire on the horn stretches into a spear of flame that runs through the target and leaves flames standing along its path.
The face becomes a small sun with a flickering corona, the field whites out and a fan of rays leaves it, the middle one burning the target.
Current crackles on both maces and two crooked strokes of lightning meet on the target, holding it in a cage of sparks.
Dust is pawed up and two great ivory tusks plough across the ground, gore the target and toss upward, throwing stones and dust.
Two torpedoes leap from the back, arc over and dive at the spot where the target stands, each throwing up a column of water; they can be dodged.
A sword of light forms overhead and falls into one widening cut that passes through the target as a bright line, with white feathers after it.
A crooked violet bolt in three restless legs jumps to the target and leaves the air around it broken into blocks of static.
Three lights and a triangle kindle at the horns, three blue horns fly and meet on the target, and a three-pointed gold star breaks out.

finishers.name: Howling Crusher

behavior.look: SaberLeomon roars, and the roar leaves it as a lion's head of amber light that bounds across the ground in one leap, fangs first;

finishers.notes: Source: "no counter"; DW1 finishers already cannot be blocked.

finishers.name: Duo Scissor Claw

behavior.look: Two great stag pincers open wide at the caster's sides and snap shut twice across the whole enemy line, each bite leaving crossed cuts on everyone.

finishers.notes: Source also lowers Defense and Power; DW1 has no debuff.

finishers.name: Nuclear Laser

behavior.look: A living missile leaves the arm on a thread of smoke and hunts the target down; the field flashes and a green fireball climbs while ash falls.

finishers.notes: Canon "Nuclear Laser": the source's "Fire Blast II" read like DarkTyrannomon's Fire Blast ("Giga Destroyer" is already MetalGreymon's name).

finishers.name: Strong Carapace

behavior.look: The spiked shell rises over the caster and fires three volleys of horn spikes that arc up and stab down on every enemy.

finishers.notes: Weak in DW2 (20).

finishers.name: Brown Stinger

behavior.look: The tail spits three long stingers in a burst; they drive into the target and violet venom spatters and bubbles up.

finishers.notes: Source inflicts poison.

finishers.name: Fungus Cruncher

behavior.look: A small toadstool lobbed tumbling at the target bursts over it in a violet cloud that hangs there shedding spores.

finishers.notes: Source: its attacks poison for the battle; a buff would need engine code, so this damaging shot is the finisher.

finishers.name: Buffalo Breath

behavior.look: A rolling green-brown gas swells as it crosses to the target and hangs on it, bubbling, dripping and reeking.

finishers.notes: Source confuses.

behavior.look: A long breath of red fire gouts from the caster's jaws and sweeps over the field, leaving every enemy licked by flames.

finishers.name: Pretty Attack

behavior.look: A kiss pops on the lips and turns into a big beating heart that drifts into the target; hearts and stars circle its head.

finishers.notes: Source seals strong techniques; confusion is the nearest DW1 status.

behavior.look: Mammothmon stamps twice, raising dust, and a pair of great ivory tusks ploughs along the ground to the target in a cloud; they gore upwards through it and stones fly.

finishers.name: S-Bone Crusher

behavior.look: A giant bone spins out in a wide boomerang curve through the enemy line, cracking each enemy as it passes, and shatters into splinters.

finishers.notes: Source shows "S-Bone"; expand to the canon name if one is confirmed.

behavior.look: A tin, a fish bone and an old boot are slung out of the can and land in splats of green stench and flies.
A grinning bomb is lobbed in a high arc with a sputtering fuse, laughs as it lands and goes up in fire, smoke and stars.
A mournful cry gathers falling tears over the caster's head, then a tall wall of water rolls out and breaks over every enemy.

finishers.name: Twig Tap

behavior.look: A forked branch swings down on the target from above, then back up from below, each tap with a smack and a burst of leaves and splinters.

finishers.notes: Source drains HP; DW1 has no drain (engine work, not proposed).

behavior.look: A slow yellow cloud glittering with pollen rolls from the flower hands to where the target stood and settles there.

finishers.name: Ninja Flower

behavior.look: Four volleys of spinning flower shuriken fly out trailing leaves and petals and burst on every enemy.

finishers.notes: Canon "Spiral Flower".

behavior.look: Scorpiomon's tail uncoils over its head segment by segment, the blade at its end held high above the target;

finishers.name: Kongou

behavior.look: Six plates of adamant close round Baihumon into a shell that rings as it hardens;

finishers.notes: Source: unbeatable during its own turn; a buff would need engine code, so this damaging dash is the finisher.

finishers.name: Metal Fireball

behavior.look: A ball of molten metal wrapped in blue flame is forged, lobbed high and bursts on the enemies, raining burning slag on each of them.

finishers.notes: Effect ported (own_effect chunk 122 on Mega Flame 63).

behavior.look: Three gouts of black ink are spat one after another trailing drops; the one that lands blots the target and splashes all around.

finishers.name: Evil Wind

behavior.look: Dark ink gusts curl out from the caster in a spreading foul wind that wraps every enemy in black-violet swirls.

finishers.notes: Source slows; stun is the nearest DW1 status.

behavior.look: A grinning pumpkin is conjured overhead, drops among the enemies and bursts, throwing rind and candy-coloured sparks over all of them.
Rings of heat draw in on Cyclonemon's arm and a white-hot jet runs to the target and holds on it, molten drops spraying from where it bites.
A little kiwi bird pelts along the ground at the target kicking up dust and bursts into feathers on whoever it runs into.

finishers.name: Pearl Shot

behavior.look: Light wells up in the open shell and a pearl flies out trailing bubbles, bursting on the target in a crown of water.

finishers.notes: One source glyph before the name is undecoded.

behavior.look: A great red claw opens beside the target and snaps shut on it, then a bigger one snaps again; each snap leaves a crossed glint and rising bubbles.

finishers.name: E-Stun Blast

behavior.look: A crackling ball of current is spat from the jaws along a jagged path and bolts stab down where it lands, leaving it twitching.

finishers.notes: Source stuns. Its specialties have no Air.

behavior.look: An egg is fired like a shell with a bang and a smoke ring, and cracks open on the target in a burst of yolk and shell.

finishers.name: Waking Dream

behavior.look: A winding trail of violet dream-smoke closes over the target, an eye opens in the coil, stares, and the nightmare bursts.

finishers.notes: Weak in DW2 (20).

behavior.look: The battle axe is hurled spinning through the enemy line and comes back for a second pass, sparking on every enemy both times.
A cannon charge of unstable energy swells at the muzzle and fires a wide shell that detonates in a ragged chaos burst over every enemy.

finishers.name: Chrono Breaker

behavior.look: A clock face of light opens over the target with racing hands that snap to twelve; the field greys as time stops and the dial breaks in rings.

finishers.notes: Source delays the target; stun.

behavior.look: The trident is thrown out of a swirl of dark water, trailing spray, and a spout of sea shoots up where it strikes.

finishers.name: Triple Forces

behavior.look: Three heads fire a red, a blue and a yellow orb one after another; they land in turn and merge into a three-coloured blast on every enemy.

finishers.notes: Weak in DW2 (30).

behavior.look: A beat of golden wings throws a broad crescent blade of light that sweeps across the field, cutting every enemy amid falling feathers.
Four data bombs are lobbed in sequence, each locking on with target brackets and bursting into pixels and digits over the enemies.
The field darkens, a slit of light opens at the eye and a writhing rope of shadow reaches the target while rings of dusk close in on it.
A bear's paw of blue light as big as the target swings down on it from above and to one side, leaving four gashes; a second set crosses the first.

finishers.name: Mugen Hadou

behavior.look: Flames climb round the caster and a burning fist flies out, growing as it goes, then a flurry of smaller fists hammers the same spot.

finishers.notes: Source "Mugenhadou"; dub-style "Infinite Wave" if the owner prefers English.

behavior.look: A knot of silk unfolds into a wide web in flight and wraps the target while venom runs along the threads and boils off in green fumes.
The ship cannon fires in a tongue of flame and a roll of smoke, and the iron ball flies low and breaks on whoever it meets in fire and splinters.
Feathers drift from SlashAngemon's wings;
An atom lights up on the chest, a hair-thin line finds the target and a hard green-white ray with six-sided collars follows it.
A dark sphere with a sneering face swells over the caster and bursts into a concert of sound waves and musical notes that rolls over every enemy.
A harpoon fish darts in a straight line in a sleeve of spray and bubbles and drives into whoever is in its way, throwing up a fan of water.
Two toothed jaws of water close over and under the target, press with rings of pressure drawing in, then crush: ice and water burst out and a spout stands where it was.
The wind gathers round GrapLeomon and leaves as a turbine of teal whirlwinds, one behind another, that bores across to the target and stands up there as a twister.
A crowned lump of muck wobbles through a lazy arc and lands with a splat and a foul cloud; the crown pops off and tumbles down.
Four times a green blur darts through the target from a different side, kicking up dust where it sets off, and each time a burning cut is left across it;
Antylamon's arms become axes: one great blade swings down across the target from the right, a second from the left, each leaving a heavy wake;
Machine-gun tracers rake the target from a starred muzzle, then rockets arc over on smoke trails and blast it.
Threads of light draw into one long needle that crosses the field in a blink leaving a pink line in the air and a cross of light where it pierces.
The ground glows and pillars of hellfire with screaming faces erupt under every enemy at once.
A glass bulb over the caster stutters on and off, then catches: the field goes white, spokes of glare shoot out and a broad shaft pins the target.

finishers.name: Nail Bone

behavior.look: A stone above the caster fills with sick yellow light and throws a beam wrapped in black lightning; a pale skull rises out of the target.

finishers.notes: Staff-cast fire identity (decision log 2026-11-04).

finishers.name: Talisman of Light

behavior.look: A paper charm thrown at the target that opens into a seal of light.

finishers.notes: Source "Bonhitsusen" (romaji); dub name used.

finishers.name: Amethyst Mandala

behavior.look: A violet wheel of petals opens from her and reaches every enemy.

finishers.notes: Source "KongouKaimandara" (romaji); dub name used.

behavior.look: A white whirlwind spins up around the caster and spreads outwards, carrying paper charms through every enemy.
A ray of holy light from the shield.
A line of gold goes up and draws a pyramid of light around the target edge by edge, then a shaft of gold pours down inside it and turquoise ankhs rise.
Two crossing cuts of the plasma blades, close up.
Rage burns red round Knightmon while a sword of steel as tall as a house takes shape in the air over the target;
The wind whirls up round Kyukimon and throws a wheel of three sickles that spins across the field;
Lynxmon's mane flares up in a crown of curling flames shedding sparks, then a widening cone of fire rolls to the target and leaves it burning.
Three finned bombs climb from the back on smoke and whistle straight down on the target one after another, each bursting in fire and iron.
Ghost lights climb round Musyamon.
Twin red beams from the chest cannons.
White streaks shoot up from Gargoylemon into the sky;
Two green crescents peel from Snimon's scythes, sweep wide to either side and close on the target like shears in a white X.
A great red eye opens lid by lid and looses a needle of red light with motes winding round it; pale wisps drift up out of the target.
The hammer arm slams the ground and a shockwave of flying rock spikes and rubble runs out from the caster under every enemy.
Dashed rings close on Vemmon;
Ten cockroaches scuttle out from under Roachmon and race across the ground in zigzags, leaving a stink behind them;
A ring of thunder drums lights up above the caster beat by beat, then lightning bolts fall on every enemy at once.

finishers.name: Necrophobia

behavior.look: A gunshot: a white muzzle flash and an instant streak, then a pale skull rises through the target with wisps of grave-mist.

finishers.notes: Gun identity (decision log 2026-11-04).

behavior.look: Two great shoulder missiles ignite and fly on roaring flames trailing smoke, landing one after the other in two huge explosions.
A spark thrown into the sky piles storm cloud over the target, which lets go two forked bolts while the field flashes and current crawls on the ground.
Flames climb Kotemon's bamboo sword;
A golden star swings in a spiral round the target and smacks into it, then a wider one swings the other way and smacks harder;
Light gathers on Bearmon's paw; a great glowing fist drives straight into the target, growing as it comes, and three rings of the blow go on through it.
Crystal shards form overhead and rain on the spot where the target stood.
Fire streams up from the ground into a small rayed sun overhead that is hurled down and raises a wall of flame and burning rock through the target.
Slivers of dark fall in on the target as the field dims, a black sphere with a torn violet rim and turning five-sided walls closes round it, then collapses and shatters.

finishers.name: Needle Squall

behavior.look: The body puffs up and bursts six waves of needles outwards in all directions, riddling every enemy.

finishers.notes: Last glyph undecoded; "Squall" read from the description.

finishers.name: Blind Attack

behavior.look: Two red eyes open over NeoCrimson and the field goes dark.

finishers.notes: Source hits friend or foe; DW1 version: a random enemy (Nightmare Syndromer rule).

finishers.name: Corona Blaster

behavior.look: Three shots from the arm cannon through a drawn seal.

finishers.notes: Source signature "Blast Mode" is a form, not an attack.

behavior.look: A black sun gathered overhead and thrown down; its blast reaches every enemy.

finishers.name: Dynamo Cannon

behavior.look: Two dynamos spin up over the shoulders and fire six blue shells by turns, each bursting orange on the target.

finishers.notes: Source "DynamoCannon" spaced.

behavior.look: Blood wells in MaloMyotismon's hand and runs out into a swaying whip that lashes the target and clings to it, dripping;
Embers stream into the jaws and come back as a widening cone of crimson and gold fire with three blasts inside it and black smoke after.
Two ropes of water corkscrew round one another to the target, where a spout bursts up and falls back as rain.
A wheel of blue fire that flies as a dragon; it can be dodged.
Dust rises under Zanbamon's hooves as it lifts a sword longer than the gap between the fighters;
A block of raw data is compiled from streaming ones and zeroes, stutters across the field and breaks over the target in squares and scan lines.
Two green cat's eyes open over the caster and loose thin rose rays that sweep in to cross on the target in a star of light and a scatter of jewels.
A ball of fire grown in the mouth and spat at the target; it can be dodged.
Flames knit into a great bird of fire overhead that dives in a straight line shedding burning feathers and wraps its wings round whoever it strikes.
The Grey Sword lights: a blade of blue-white light with written signs burning orange along it grows from Omnimon across the field and through the target.
